lines.1: 「And that's what happened! What do you think, Yashi!?」
lines.3: 「Hey! I'm a poor soul wandering the streets at night, and I just happened to run into someone I know! Of course I'm gonna vent!」
lines.6: 「You've said everything you wanted and you're satisfied now, right? Hurry up and get out of my sight.」
lines.7: 「Yashi, do YOU think Leo's cooler than me too!?」
lines.10: 「Neither of you is cool. You're both hopeless.」
lines.13: 「You're the only one who put us on the same level! I'm grateful!」
lines.15: 「I said you're both hopeless... What a weird guy.」
